lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is broader in the anterior region and becomes progressively denser toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 3rd and 5th lines (counting from the posterior).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is a short diagonal segment. The second and third anterior lines terminate mid-torso. Several posterior lines fragment into clusters of spots before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A high-density cluster of approximately 9-11 distinct white spots is located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower posterior haunch align in a diagonal trajectory toward the calcaneus.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots are present on the cheek below the eye. A large white patch is visible on the upper portion of the front left limb, and a white band is visible just above the hoof of the same limb.
